name: 71047 · Keithville, LA
findings: ZIP 71047 (Keithville) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71047 (Keithville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
